Domestics Strongholds will need the appointed officers to hold various posts, so that the domestics of strongholds can be developed. The Governor requires management ability the most, while the Aide requires agricultural, commercial, and technical skills.

Domestics Compulsory conscription will cost money, and will reduce popular sentiment and increase discontent of people in the strongholds. A military commander with a higher righteousness and justice, seeing the people suffer, his loyalty will also be affected.

Deployment Up to 20 officer troops can be deployed in one legion, and up to 500 infantry, 250 cavalry, 125 large units in one troop. All officers defending the city can enter the battle, and there is no limit of 20 troops.

Deployment The daily grains consumption of the legion on the expedition is related to the unit types: 1-4 points for infantry, 4-7 points for cavalry, 7-10 points of Mahouts and vehicles; The historically famous units has higher combat power and will consume more grains.

Expedition When the legion marches on the global map, it will consume grains over time; Lack of food will cause the troop's combat effectiveness to decline. Before starting a war, the treasury should prepare enough grains; When there is a shortage of food, it is recommended not to send several legions to attack in multiple directions at the same time.

Battlefield In battle, there are up to 5 officer troops on one side in the battlefield. Once an officer dies or retreats, new officers of the legion will be deployed according to the order, until all officers are deployed.

Battlefield During a battle, the limit of soldiers on the battlefield of each unit: Up to 100 infantry, 50 cavalry, and 25 Mahouts and vehicles; When unit dies, it will be automatically replenished to the battlefield; until the commander officer being killed, or the winner being chosen, or all soldiers on the battlefield being killed.

Battlefield According to the battling order, the troops that can restrain the enemy should be deployed to the battlefield to gain an advantage. It can be adjusted during the pre-war Assessment stage or during the battle.
Battlefield During a siege battle, no matter which section of the wall or fort is attacked, the HP of it is calculated for the whole. You can choose the strategically best section to attack.
Battlefield In the battle, the officers with low HP can retreat immediately to protect their lives, but those who have retreated can no longer battle.
Battlefield The condition for victory in a battle is the annihilation or retreat of all the officers on one side. In a siege battle, you can also win by breaking through a stronghold.

Battlefield If failed in a battle, the officers who were not captured can directly fled back to the starting stronghold. The winner occupies the stronghold, or continues with its actions on the global map.

Battlefield In quick response events of Duel, as the dynamic blue "Judgment Aura" shrinks from the outside to the inside, press the button to judge. The perfect strike will be performed when it coincides with the red "Mad Dance Aura".

Opening When selecting the faction, set whether to enable "Die in Battle". When it is disabled, Duel will be accessible, but the officers won't die. Officers can only retreat or be captured, the monarch is not subject to this restriction.
Battlefield When the monarch is captured, he can only be released or beheaded, regardless of whether "Die in Battle" is enabled. If the monarch is beheaded, a successor will be automatically chosen.

Ending Conditions for "Endless Troubled Times": the player's faction perished before 334 A.D. ; or When the time limit is up, the number of player's faction strongholds is less than 3/4 of the total number of all strongholds.
Ending Conditions for "Unification of the World": Before 334 AD, except for the player's faction, all other factions have perished.
Ending Conditions for "Suspended Troubled Times": At the ending time of 334 A.D., The number of player's faction strongholds is more than 3/4 of the total number of all strongholds.
Exploration If the legion stays on the global map for a period of time, it will explore the surrounding area. Without soldiers and food, nothing will be discovered...

Expedition The legion deployment, selection of the highest official position of the legion commander and the max number of troops he can lead. The higher the intelligence of the legion commander, the greater the effectiveness of the morale boost.

Strategy War is a terrible thing. Regardless of victory or defeat, it causes financial losses and many casualties. The highest form of generalship is to balk the enemy's plans, so the skillful leader subdues the enemy's troops without any fighting; Defeat the enemy through psychological attack is the best way to control the war!

Diplomacy The highest form of generalship is to balk the enemy's plans; the next best is to prevent the junction of the enemy's forces. If there is not enough strength to conquer the enemy, it is better to make more friends than more enemies; befriend the distant enemy while attack a nearby enemy, avoid being attacked by the enemy from both sides, and take advantage of the situation to cultivate your own strength.

Assessment Before the formal engagement, the strength gap between you and the enemy should be carefully assessed. If there is a good chance of victory, you should boost the morale of your army; If you will probably be defeated, retreat should be the best choice. In this case, retreat is regarded as a tie, and most of the officers can withdraw; Once entered the battlefield, the defeated officers will probably be captured alive.

Morale In the battle between the two sides, the physical action is always driven by the strength of the mind. When your officers kill enemy officers and soldiers with high fighting spirit, it will boost the morale of the whole army, and they will deal additional damage to the enemy.

Position Officers can gain experience through domestics or participating in battles. As their level increases, they can be promoted to higher-ranking official positions to increase the number of troops and units on the expedition. But salaries must be paid to the positions. Too many useless high-ranking officers will be a heavy burden on the people...

Stronghold Upgrade When the agriculture, commerce, and technique of the stronghold reach the cap, it can be upgraded, up to Level 5. After the upgradation, there will be more population, more funds and grains, and available higher-level ancillary buildings and units.

Scourge Every once in a while there is a chance of natural disasters such as "good harvest, poor harvest, locust plague", etc.; when Discontent of the people in the strongholds are high, "Riots" will occur, which will cause the operation of the strongholds to be suspended.

Ancillary building The clearings of the stronghold can be used to construct auxiliary buildings, and each auxiliary building has different functions, which will indirectly affect the development of the stronghold and even the country. Do you wish a great prosperous livelihood of the people or to make all armed might indulge in aggressive wars? In the early, middle and late stages of the state's development, appropriate adjustments should also be made, and it depends on the your decision!

Terrains The terrain type of the global map and the battlefield will affect the movement speed: Fast moving on the road, slow on the sand, mud and water; rough terrains such as snow, swamp, and magma will grant negative effects; entering deep water and the cliff will lead directly to death.

Climate The battlefields in North China, Central China, and South China have different climatic characteristics. Fair weather, sand, fog, rain, snow, all will affect the movement speed and combat ability of all units on the battlefield; downwind or headwind affects the damage of the projected weapons such as bows and crossbows.

Officers Aging If you start a new game and choose a challenge mode with Officers Aging, the abilities of the officers will be linked to their age. Please cherish and make good use of those officers who are strong and at their peak!

Units Upgrade It is unable to engage the enemy without enough preparation. Armies are to be maintained in the course of a long period, but to be used in the nick of time. Soldiers all over the country should be trained usually to improve their level and response ability; no matter the active strike, or passive counterattack, you should get them prepared with sufficient combat power to reverse the situation on the battlefield!

Get Equipment In order to improve combat power by obtaining more fine weapons, equipment and carrying facilities, you can either loot the bandit forts or buy them from visiting the travelling merchants. There will be travelling merchants on the global map from time to time!

Funds & Grains Trading In the process of national development, sometimes the dilemma of insufficient funds or grains may occasionally occur, and temporary transaction for emergency turnover is required. The amount of funds and grains traded every quarter will be affected by grain banks and major grain merchants. Before trading, please check whether the related ancillary buildings have been built.

Travelling Merchants It is said that the merchants dare to go deep into dangerous places and seek profits. Merchants will occasionally bring some unusual goods that are rarely seen; Whenever a merchant visits, remember to buy what you need!

Ministers Highly active ministers can effectively assist in the management of the state. Properly choose the officers to serve as ministers of Domestics, Personnel, and Strategy; And don't forget to authorize appropriately so that the ministers can work more efficiently!
Recruit Recruiting officers will refer to the target officer's loyalty, justice, ranks, and interpersonal relationship. It would be even better if you can bring a gift that he/she likes!

Gifting A small number of officers take justice as the principles and do not easily accept gifts and reduce their loyalty. Most officers have desires: treasures, woman, reputation, social status, food and wine, mystical weapons and steeds, appearances, poetry and melody, and even family members, etc.; choosing what they like can affect their minds.

Exile The exiled officers will be resentful and dissatisfied with their country and it will last for several years, which will be difficult to be recruited again in a short time. If it is not for the case of overstaffed and financial constraints, please be cautious to implement the exile order!

Monarch Order When assigning an officer to perform a task, it takes 1 Monarch Order. If there is no Monarch Order, no new tasks can be dispatched. You need to wait until the previously dispatched tasks are completed or cancelled to free up the available Monarch Orders.

Monarch Order The number of Monarch Orders will be affected by the total number of officers of the faction. The more officers there are, the more available Monarch Orders there will be. The cap of the Monarch Orders will be affected by the monarch's action power. The higher the monarch's action power, the higher the cap of the Monarch Order.

Battlefield When your combat power is much greater than the enemy's, you can switch "Manual Combat" to"Automatic Combat". During Automatic Combat, the player can still control the camera to check the whole situation, and at the right time, click (on the left) the ultimate still button on the avatar of your officer to turn the tide of the battle!
